name: Hitman 2: Silent Assassin
description: Hitman 2: Silent Assassin is a singleplayer third-person stealth game and the second in the Hitman series.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX
audio_settings.reason: Automatically enables EAX in Hitman 2: Silent Assassin's configuration.

optional_settings.title: Raise sound buffers
optional_settings.reason: Hitman 2: Silent Assassin can play more sounds at once with its sound buffers at the maximum of 128.

optional_settings.title: Raise graphics quality
optional_settings.reason: Automatically sets Hitman 2: Silent Assassin draw distance, level of detail, shadow detail and antialiasing at its highest settings.
